author: Cubbe
body:
Hello,

I want to know if I can get this punishment appealed. To be honest, I dd not know what happened. I just contacted my old captain (NovaLikesPvP) and he told me he got banned for ban evading on another teammate account called "Saikron". But I realised about this ban today. I was wondering if I can get this punishment appealed because I did not know he was ban evading, furthermore, I did not play any single match of the tournament because i was busy with some school things, and now that I want to play this tourney with other team (my team that moved from ocn to avicus) I can't because of this ban. Please appeal me, its kind of unfair for me since i did not know he was ban evading, how would I assist him to ban evade? Please, I hope you understand me.


Thanks for your time...



-Miyuh
